children: Midnight plans to add real-world asset issuance in Q1 2027. The release will let institutions issue tokens backed by investment funds, credit products and real estate on the network.

Institutions will also be able to shield the tokens they issue, allowing them to use private tokens for these assets. The release gives NIGHT exposure to a wider range of institutional asset activity.
So, let’s take a look at what
has planned for us in 2027, and there’s a lot, so we’re going to break it down into categories:
💎 Programmable Shielded Assets - Private tokens with built-in compliance controls, including…

title: Midnight: Real-world asset issuance opens to institutions - Q1 2027
